{{Top|leg}}
'''''Retuna''''' was a [[Class-A cargo container]] that was part of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] starfighter base. The base was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']] and was destroyed.
